message: SPEC required a tracked, append-per-tool-call provenance log plus per-commit [stage:][task:] tags. Foundry's clean-tree check on task_done and its fixed `<ID>:` subjects and MCP-authored progress/review commits forced workarounds: a gitignored live log with phase-end snapshots, and a commit-msg hook. The skill has no guidance for projects that must log or tag Foundry's own activity.

Canterbury corpus URL (https://corpus.canterbury.ac.nz/resources/cantrbry.tar.gz, the only allowlisted URL per SPEC/guard) returns HTTP 403 from Cloudflare bot management in this sandbox network, confirmed with retries and full browser-like headers; not a script bug. Silesia (also allowlisted) downloads fine (200). Per PLAN.md P0-08 explicit instruction ("Canterbury is required: if it cannot be downloaded after 3 attempts, block the task"), this blocks P0-08 and cascades to skip most corpus-dependent downstream tasks, which is a large portion of the remaining plan. This is an environment/network constraint outside the implementer's control, not something a different script approach can fix.
